title: MemeScouts@LT-EDI 2026: Asking the Right Questions - Prompted Weak Supervision for Meme Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying multimodal memes as homophobic using prompted weak supervision, where a vision-language model answers targeted, question-based labeling functions regarding target identification, explicit/implicit hate, and stance.

Detecting transphobia in memes by extracting structured features via a vision-language model queried with specific labeling functions (e.g., assessing insults toward transgender people or denial of trans identities).

Comparing model performance and analyzing feature pruning overlap (using Jaccard similarity) across English, Hindi, and Chinese datasets to identify Western-centric biases in labeling functions and cross-lingual performance disparities.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
